name: Boiled tapioca with sesame salt
summary: Boiled cassava at the tunnels, eaten with sesame salt and hot tea. The same root is also dipped in salt.
origin: The tunnels at Củ Chi. The Ho Chi Minh City Tourism Promotion Center places it at the underground Hoàng Cầm kitchen. Tuổi Trẻ places boiled cassava dipped in salt on the relic.
howToEat: At the Hoàng Cầm kitchen it comes with sesame salt and hot tea. Tuổi Trẻ dips boiled cassava in salt.
where: The Hoàng Cầm kitchen on the relic.
seoTitle: Boiled tapioca at the Cu Chi tunnels
seoDescription: Boiled cassava at the Cu Chi tunnels, with sesame salt and hot tea, or dipped in salt.
